scope: Use the comparison study's frozen decoder, 50-step windows in quarters 2–4, both starting labels and all four grids. Only the first quarter of a new repeat may tune its prefix forecast.

policies.always: Issue the original repeat-0 forecast on every grid.
policies.static: Issue the original forecast for an observable and starting label if its largest absolute development error on every grid was at most one point.
policies.prefix: On each grid form an interval centered on the prefix forecast with radius equal to the largest absolute local-prefix error on that grid in repeats 3–5. Clip to [0,1]. Issue the original forecast only if every interval is contained in the one-point tolerance around the original forecast.

criterion: For each repeat, observable, and starting label, a released forecast misses if any grid error exceeds one point. Report releases, released misses, withheld misses, and withheld accurate forecasts. Also report empirical coverage of the frozen prefix intervals. A maximum observed error from three development repeats carries no field guarantee.
